ruleDefinitions.name: Unusual Parent Process For Cmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious parent process for cmd.exe

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ctfmon\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\epad\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\FlashPlayerUpdateService\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\GoogleUpdate\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\jucheck\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\jusched\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\LogonUI\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\SearchIndexer\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\SearchProtocolHost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\SIHClient\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sihost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\slui\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sppsvc\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\taskhostw\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\unsecapp\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wermgr\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wlanext\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WUDFHost\\\.exe$")))
